audience: support and sales teams who take phone calls with Aircall

useCases.title: Review recent calls by date, number or tag
useCases.text: The AI lists calls from a creation-date window or searches them by phone number, tag or direction. You get a short list of who called and how each call went.

useCases.title: Summarize a call and list its follow-ups
useCases.text: The AI reads the AI summary, action items and transcription of a call. You get the main points and what someone must do next.

useCases.title: Check the sentiment and topics of a call
useCases.text: The AI reads the AI sentiment analysis and detected topics of a call. You see how the customer felt and what the call was about.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI searches the shared address book by name, phone number or email. It can create a contact or change fields of an existing one.

useCases.title: Tag a call or add a note to it
useCases.text: The AI reads your call tags, applies tags to a call by tag id and adds a comment to the call.

useCases.title: See your agents, teams and phone numbers
useCases.text: The AI lists users (agents) with their availability, teams with their members, and the numbers the company owns. You see who is available and how the team is set up.
